A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (20 February 2023). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-D-u3po-PC-Errata-2023-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio)]]: The game text changes: “Deploy on opponent's side” becomes “Deploys only to a site”; “spy (except that if present during a battle” becomes “spy. If Undercover”; “site,” becomes “battle,”; “its” becomes “his”; “Side).” becomes “Side.”; “spy's” becomes “U-3PO just had his”; “is” is removed; “the above "game text" is canceled and” is removed; “use as if 'stolen.'” becomes “steal him.”. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels with the corrected text and the mark “D-E1” in the lower border.

The whole printed card image and the whole 2023 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
